description: User cannot recall the account email and offers a username-shaped handle (e.g. mei_kovacs_8020) plus ZIP; the agent refuses to authenticate instead of deriving first/last name from the handle, so the conversation ends with zero tool calls.
proposed_fix: Prompt: when the customer offers a username/user-id-shaped handle, parse first and last name from it and authenticate via find_user_id_by_name_zip with the provided ZIP.

verification.success_criterion: In one subset run: >=5 of the 7 member tasks pass, including >=3 of the 4 deterministic members (5, 8, 9, 67), AND 5/5 controls (12, 24, 60, 76, 111) pass.

description: When proposing an exchange with a price difference, the agent assumes the original payment method instead of asking; the user declines the otherwise-correct proposal.
proposed_fix: Prompt: ask which payment method to use for exchange price differences instead of assuming the original.

verification.success_criterion: Task 52 passes (98 informational; failed only 2/3 baselines).

description: On exchanges the agent echoes the customer's existing item id or picks the wrong sibling variant instead of resolving the requested options to the correct item id via get_product_details.
proposed_fix: Prompt: exchanges must look up the product's variants and select the item id matching the requested options; never reuse the old item id unless the options are identical.

description: When modifying an address the agent rewrites unchanged fields in non-canonical form (country 'United States' vs the DB's 'USA'), failing the DB end-state check.
proposed_fix: Prompt: when modifying addresses, copy unchanged fields verbatim from the existing record.
